question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the shipped `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or close this issue and the linked PR as obsolete now that current main uses `skill_workshop` for durable skill creation?
rationale: Automation can prove the released helper is affected and that the linked PR fixes that old surface, but current main removed the helper and the supported skill-creation workflow now points at `skill_workshop`, which is a maintainer product-boundary choice.

options.title: Close obsolete helper path
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported skill-creation path.

options.title: Refresh or backport helper repair
options.body: Sponsor a refreshed PR or release backport that intentionally keeps the helper supported, preserves current tests, and adds mixed-case resource parsing coverage.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete helper path
recommendation.body: Close the linked PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported skill-creation path.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the bundled `skill-creator` helper surface and is the clearest history route for whether that shipped helper remains supported.
